acceptanceCriteria: A retained measurement on synthetic stores at 1k/10k tickets and 13k/50k/100k receipts reports wall time, CPU seconds and peak RSS per read command (median of 5, load band recorded).
Every read whose cost grows with receipt history rather than with live state is either made proportional to live state (e.g. via a derived, verifiable checkpoint) or recorded with its owner ticket.
Read semantics, lock-freedom and refusals are unchanged; tests cover any new derived state's fallback.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Owner, 2026-10-06: really large projects must be handled without slowdowns. Production Flow-Proof queue already has 13,121 receipts (153 MB) and receipt audit takes 56 s (#641). V1-0645 covers the writer path; this covers reads (queue status, roadmap, ticket search/show, plan preview, claim --next selection, attempt show, receipt audit) and journal/archive growth.

Manual route because native completion is refused for a reason unrelated to evidence: on V1-0904, claim, submit (tree 6b9f2b71) and gate run focused-docs in a clean worktree at the merge commit all succeeded, but complete --commit 8c02f255 refused STALE_TREE with warning 'commit 8c02f2552421b718b9d9b94d75f6d0afc1a11984 is not reachable from main'. Local main in the primary checkout is cd70ba0a and holds 2,651 uncommitted paths that may not be touched, so it cannot be fast-forwarded; that attempt was released with reason STALE_TREE. NOT_RUN: make gate, -race, live fleet qualification where the spec says so; macOS CPU ticks not delivered (decision 0439 limits).

title: corvint-tasks: reads, claim selection and receipt audit must stay fast on very large queues (10k tickets, 100k receipts)
